style_prefix: Photorealistic architectural photography style. Straight-on view, subject fills the frame. Soft even daylight, no harsh shadows. Clean, neutral, upscale-residential finish. No people, no text, no watermarks, no brand logos. Square composition, crisp focus throughout.
